From: Rachel Vance (r.vance@vancetech.com)

Subject: Incomplete Shipment - Order #TK-9804

Dear Mr. Sterling,
I am writing to express urgent concern regarding purchase order #TK-9804 delivered to our assembly facility yesterday afternoon. According to the original invoice dated October 20, our order included 50 heavy-duty hydraulic actuators and 12 digital pressure gauges.

Rachel Vance, Director of Global Procurement

- Register your product serial number at www.omnitechelectronics.com/warranty within 30 days of purchase.

- Ship the unit in its original protective packaging to our regional repair hub in Denver, Colorado. OmniTech covers all return freight charges for verified warranty services.

Product Warranty & User Guide: OmniTech Laser Projector (Model: PT-9200X)
Thank you for purchasing the OmniTech PT-9200X Laser Projector. OmniTech Electronics guarantees that this product is free from defects in material and workmanship under normal commercial usage for a period of three (3) years from the original purchase date.
Warranty Terms & Limitations:
1. Optical Laser Light Source: Guaranteed for 20,000 operational hours or three years, whichever occurs first. If the laser engine output drops below 50% of rated luminosity within this timeframe, OmniTech will replace the optical module at no cost.
2. Physical Damage: This warranty does not cover damage resulting from accidental drops, liquid spills, unauthorized disassembly, power surges, or failure to clean the intake air filters according to the schedule in Section 4.
3. Warranty Claims Process:
To initiate a warranty repair or replacement claim:
- Register your product serial number at www.omnitechelectronics.com/warranty within 30 days of purchase.
- Contact our Technical Support Center at 1-800-555-OMNI to receive a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) tracking number.
- Ship the unit in its original protective packaging to our regional repair hub in Denver, Colorado. OmniTech covers all return freight charges for verified warranty services.
Note on Air Filter Maintenance:
Air filters must be inspected and vacuumed every 100 operating hours to prevent internal thermal throttling. Replacement filter packs (Part #FL-402) can be ordered directly from our website.
